note: The shape of what a Lever apply page's own GET /searchLocations?text=... answers, read on two public postings on two boards with a generic city name typed into the Location field. Every value here is fictional; only the keys, the value types and the content type are as read. The real answer was a JSON array of four objects, each with a place name (city, state or region, country) and a 40-character hexadecimal id. The page reads the name for its list and writes the chosen object, as JSON, into the hidden selectedLocation field.
